segments.name: Dongfang Paper
segments.description: Produces offset printing paper, corrugating medium paper and tissue paper for customers in China.
segments.evidence: Since March 10, 2010, Baoding Shengde started its operations and thereafter the Company manages its operations through three business operating segments: Dongfang Paper and Tengsheng Paper, which produces offset printing paper, corrugating medium paper and tissue paper, and Baoding Shengde, which produces face masks and digital photo paper.
